title.zh: 有限多个标签所确定者

statement.en: In a world a list of N holds, a feature is learnable through the map exactly where an extrapolation given at most N labelled names of N - 1 values learns it; its labels include every value the feature takes once it rests; where the map carries the feature, labels before a bound fix every later one.
statement.zh: 在由 N 个构形的列表容纳的世界中，一个特征经映射可学，恰当被给予至多 N 个、各 N - 1 个值的带标签名字的外推学得它；其标签含特征在它停息后所取的每个值；映射带着特征之处，界之前的标签确定此后的每一个。

laws.en: A table of labelled names: a name is a finite future through the map, latest first, and a label a value of the feature; the extrapolation given a table unrolls the extrapolation by elimination over the lasso candidates and proposes the label of the first entry whose name the proposed future begins with.
laws.zh: 带标签的名字之表：名字是有限的经映射的未来（最近的在前），标签是特征的一个值；被给予表的外推展开套索候选上的逐除外推，提出所提议之未来以其名字开头的第一个条目的标签。

laws.en: In a world a list of N holds, where configurations with the same future through the map have features agreeing from some step on, the extrapolation given the table of the N configurations as many steps on as the list is long, each named by its first N - 1 values through the map and labelled with its feature, rests in accord with the feature along every orbit and every run, from the bound of the extrapolation given nothing on; so a feature is learnable exactly where the extrapolation given some table of at most N labelled names of N - 1 values learns it.
laws.zh: 在由 N 个构形的列表容纳的世界中，经映射未来相同的构形其特征自某步起一致之处，被给予世界之表（列表长度那么多步之后的 N 个构形，各以其经映射的前 N - 1 个值命名、以其特征为标签）的外推，自不被给予任何东西的外推之界起，沿每条轨道与每次运行与特征相合而停息；所以一个特征可学，恰当被给予某个至多 N 个、各 N - 1 个值的带标签名字之表的外推学得它。

laws.en: Every value the feature takes from the step an extrapolation given a table rests on is a label of an entry of the table; where the law leaves every configuration unchanged, every value the feature takes is.
laws.zh: 自被给予表的外推停息之步起，特征所取的每个值都是表中某条目的标签；律使每个构形不变之处，特征所取的每个值都是。

laws.en: Where the map also carries the feature, every feature is learned by the extrapolation given nothing in a world a list holds, from the bound on, along every orbit and every run, and unrolled it proposes the feature at every step ahead: the labels before the bound fix every later one.
laws.zh: 映射也带着特征之处，在由一个列表容纳的世界中，每个特征都由不被给予任何东西的外推自界起、沿每条轨道与每次运行学得；展开后它提出此后每一步的特征：界之前的标签确定此后的每一个。

hypotheses.en: No axiom. A determined law; a list holding the world (or the orbit, for the labels along the course); values through the map compared decidably, and the feature's values too where the map carries it.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。一个确定之律；一个容纳世界（或就沿进程的标签而言，轨道）的列表；经映射的值可判定地比较，映射带着特征之处其值亦然。

does_not_show.en: An extrapolation that finds the table: the table of the world is built from the world, the law and the feature, as fromWorld is.
does_not_show.zh: 找到这张表的外推：世界之表由世界、律与特征构成，如 fromWorld。

does_not_show.en: That names of fewer than N - 1 values, or fewer than N entries, fail in some world of N configurations (for telling configurations apart N - 1 is exact, Law.sameFuture_classes_exact; for the extrapolation given a table it is not stated); undetermined processes; probabilistic or approximate learning.
does_not_show.zh: 少于 N - 1 个值的名字或少于 N 个条目在某个 N 构形的世界中失败（就区分构形而言 N - 1 是精确的，Law.sameFuture_classes_exact；就被给予表的外推而言未陈述）；不确定的过程；概率的或近似的学习。

next_delta.en: Whether N - 1 values and N entries are needed for the extrapolation given a table; a table found rather than given; undetermined processes; an independent review.
next_delta.zh: 被给予表的外推是否需要 N - 1 个值与 N 个条目；找到而不是被给予的表；不确定的过程；独立审查。

correspondence.en: The chapter's open programme (section 8.2, Learning) named "learning a target from finitely many of its values, given part of a reading of the future rather than the whole". Ren, 18 October 2026: "alright, generally agree, please make your own pareto frontier decisions, and push the frontier - words are important, but i think you are capable" (provenance, not warrant); the AI chose the item. A table of labelled names is the finite part of the reading that suffices; the labels along the course are feedback the map carries.
correspondence.zh: 本章开放纲领（第 8.2 节，学习）列出“learning a target from finitely many of its values, given part of a reading of the future rather than the whole”。Ren，2026年10月18日："alright, generally agree, please make your own pareto frontier decisions, and push the frontier - words are important, but i think you are capable"（来历，不是根据）；此项由 AI 选定。带标签名字之表是读法中足够的有限部分；沿进程的标签是映射所带的反馈。

aliases: 有限多个标签所确定者

detail.en: There a learnable feature is a reading of the future, a function on whole futures; here a finite part of it, at most N labelled names of N - 1 values, suffices.
detail.zh: 那里可学特征是对未来的读法，即整个未来上的函数；这里其有限部分（至多 N 个、各 N - 1 个值的带标签名字）就足够。

detail.en: There learnability is characterized with an extrapolation built from the law (fromLaw); here the extrapolation given a finite table learns every learnable feature, and where the map carries the feature along the course every feature is learned given nothing.
detail.zh: 那里以依律所建之外推（fromLaw）刻画可学性；这里被给予有限之表的外推学得每个可学特征，映射沿进程带着特征之处，每个特征都不被给予任何东西而学得。

detail.en: Moore's bound N - 1 (Law.sameFuture_iff_within) gives the length of the names.
detail.zh: Moore 之界 N - 1（Law.sameFuture_iff_within）给出名字的长度。
